note: Pinned fixed sample for pilot cff0549a5319 (wq#1901). 8 short-answer prompts with an exact-match ground truth, chosen to be easy to grade programmatically. Same 8 prompts are used for baseline and treatment arms.

items.prompt: What is 17 * 23? Answer with only the number.
A train travels 60 miles in 90 minutes. What is its speed in miles per hour? Answer with only the number.
If a farmer has 3 sheep and all but 2 die, how many sheep are left? Answer with only the number.
What is the sum of the first 10 positive integers? Answer with only the number.
Sally has 5 apples. She gives away 2 and buys 4 more. How many apples does she have? Answer with only the number.
What is 144 divided by 12? Answer with only the number.
A book costs $12. It is discounted by 25%. What is the new price in dollars? Answer with only the number.
How many letters are in the word 'consensus'? Answer with only the number.
